exposure: Safe Surgery 2020 intervention (multi-component intervention to improve surgical quality)
Analysis by procedure type (laparotomy, cesarean delivery)
cohort: Patients undergoing surgery at 20 health centers, district hospitals, and regional hospitals in Tanzania's Lake Zone
finding: The Safe Surgery 2020 intervention did not significantly impact the postoperative mortality rate after 10 months.
mod_finding: The postoperative mortality rate for cesarean delivery was 0.24%.
